Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: This is a specialized immunopeptidomics study focusing on proteasome-catalyzed peptide splicing (PCPS). Standard bottom-up pipelines will fail to identify the 'spliced' peptides because they are non-contiguous and do not match standard protein databases. The analysis requires a de novo sequencing approach or a custom database containing spliced permutations.
